title: 🙂 टुनटुन चूहा की माला अटकी... आ की मात्रा बिना नाम कैसे बदलेगा? #hindikids #matra
title_alts: 😊 टुनटुन चूहा और आ की मात्रा... खड़ी लाइन म को मा कैसे बना देती है? #hindikids #matra
🤔 टुनटुन चूहा का काना छूट गया... मात्रा बिना माला शब्द क्यों अधूरा? #hindikids #matra
description_hook: आ की मात्रा यानी खड़ी लाइन वाला काना। एक ही स्ट्रोक म को मा बना देता है, और बच्चे यहीं अटकते हैं।

characters.name: टुनटुन चूहा
characters.description: four year old grey mouse, round ears, red kurta with a single pocket, a white chalk stub always in that pocket

scenes.narration: आज सीखेंगे आ की मात्रा, यानी खड़ी लाइन वाला काना।
scenes.caption: Today we learn the aa maatra, the standing line called kaana.
scenes.image_brief: A pale wooden slate resting on a woven floor mat, the Hindi letter आ chalked large in white at its centre and one short vertical stroke drawn beside it, a chalk stub lying on the mat, warm morning light from a nearby window, calm and inviting.

scenes.narration: म के आगे काना लगाओ। म बना मा। आ की मात्रा, मा।
scenes.caption: Put a kaana after ma and ma becomes maa. Aa maatra, maa.
scenes.image_brief: Two flat clay tiles lying side by side on a bright yellow cloth, the left tile painted with the Hindi letter म, the right tile with मा and its vertical kaana stroke picked out in red paint, soft even daylight, tidy and clear.

scenes.narration: माला देखो, मोतियों की माला। शुरू में मा, आ की मात्रा वाला।
scenes.caption: Look at maala, a necklace of beads. It begins with maa.
scenes.image_brief: A string of round wooden beads coiled on a jute mat, a small white card leaning beside it with the Hindi word माला written in thick black letters and the kaana stroke traced in red, warm afternoon light, quiet mood.

scenes.narration: मेरे साथ बोलो। म में काना, मा। तीन बार बोलो।
scenes.caption: Say it with me. Ma plus kaana, maa. Say it three times.
scenes.image_brief: A large upright picture card standing on a low table showing म on the left and मा on the right in thick letters, a red wooden pointer stick lying across the card, three small beads placed in a row below it, bright even light, cheerful mood.

scenes.narration: काना लगा, म बोला मा! माला में वही मा छिपा है।
scenes.caption: Kaana added, ma says maa! The same maa hides inside maala.
scenes.image_brief: A bead necklace lying beside a dark slate where मा is chalked three times in white, each kaana stroke thick and clear, two tiny brass bells resting on the mat, warm sunlight falling across the slate, happy mood.

scenes.narration: खाना देखो, थाली में गरम खाना। खा में आ की मात्रा।
scenes.caption: Look at khaana, hot food on a plate. Khaa carries the aa maatra.
scenes.image_brief: A steel thali of warm rice and dal on a kitchen counter with thin steam rising, a folded paper card leaning against the plate showing the Hindi word खाना in bold letters with its kaana strokes in red, soft golden kitchen light.

scenes.narration: बादल भी ऐसा है। बा में काना, आ की मात्रा।
scenes.caption: Baadal works the same way. Baa has a kaana, the aa maatra.
scenes.image_brief: One fluffy white cloud in a wide blue sky above a green field, a small wooden signboard at the edge of the field painted with the Hindi word बादल and a red kaana stroke, clear midday light, open and airy mood.

scenes.narration: बताओ, काना मन में है या माला में? माला में, आ की मात्रा।
scenes.caption: Which has a kaana, man or maala? Maala does, with the aa maatra.
scenes.image_brief: Two flash cards lying apart on a blue tablecloth, one showing the Hindi word मन and one showing माला, the kaana stroke inside माला outlined in bright red, even daylight, playful mood.

scenes.narration: माला, खाना, बादल, तीनों में आ की मात्रा। काना लगा, म बोला मा!
scenes.caption: Maala, khaana, baadal all carry aa maatra. Kaana added, ma says maa!
scenes.image_brief: Three cards in a row on a pale wooden floor showing माला, खाना and बादल, every kaana stroke traced in red, a string of beads curling beside the cards, warm evening light, satisfied mood.

title: 😮 बबलू हाथी का अंडा शब्द उलझा... बिंदी न लगे तो आवाज़ कहाँ खोई? #hindikids #bindi
title_alts: 🌟 बबलू हाथी और ऊपर वाली बिंदी... नन्ही बिंदी शब्द को कैसे गुनगुनाती है? #hindikids #bindi
😯 बबलू हाथी की बिंदी मिट गई... बिना बिंदी बंदर शब्द क्यों बिगड़ता है? #hindikids #bindi
description_hook: अक्षर के ऊपर एक नन्ही बिंदी, और पूरी आवाज़ नाक से गूँज उठती है। अंडा, बंदर, रंग, घंटी, चारों में वही बिंदी है।

characters.name: बबलू हाथी
characters.description: five year old grey elephant calf, short round trunk, blue striped dungarees, one yellow bell tied to his left ankle

scenes.narration: आज एक छोटी बिंदी सीखेंगे, जो शब्द को गुनगुनाती है।
scenes.caption: Today we learn the tiny bindi that makes a word hum.
scenes.image_brief: A white slate propped against a courtyard wall with one small black dot chalked high above a single Hindi letter, a piece of chalk resting on the ledge below, soft early daylight, quiet and curious mood.

scenes.narration: अक्षर के ऊपर एक बिंदी। बिंदी बोली, अं। बिंदी, अं।
scenes.caption: One bindi sits above the letter. The bindi says un. Bindi, un.
scenes.image_brief: A big painted wooden card showing the Hindi syllable अं, the dot above it painted glossy red and much larger than the letter beneath, plain cream background, even bright light, clear and simple.

scenes.narration: अंडा बोलो। शुरू में अं, वही बिंदी वाली आवाज़।
scenes.caption: Say anda. It starts with un, the very sound of the bindi.
scenes.image_brief: Two smooth white eggs in a small steel bowl on a kitchen shelf, a card behind the bowl showing the Hindi word अंडा with its bindi painted red, warm morning kitchen light, homely mood.

scenes.narration: अब मेरे साथ। अं, अंडा। दो बार बोलो, बिंदी के साथ।
scenes.caption: Now with me. Un, anda. Say it twice, with the bindi.
scenes.image_brief: An open cloth flip book standing on a kitchen table, the visible page showing अं and अंडा in thick letters with both bindis circled in red, a wooden spoon lying beside the book, bright even light, inviting mood.

scenes.narration: बिंदी लगी, आवाज़ गूँजी! अंडा में वही बिंदी है।
scenes.caption: Bindi added, the sound hums! That same bindi lives in anda.
scenes.image_brief: A steel bowl of white eggs beside a slate where अंडा is chalked three times, every bindi drawn extra large in red, tiny paper stars scattered on the table, warm light, celebratory mood.

scenes.narration: बंदर सुनो। बं में बिंदी, आवाज़ नाक से गूँजती है।
scenes.caption: Listen to bandar. Ban has a bindi, so the sound hums.
scenes.image_brief: A carved wooden toy monkey sitting on a courtyard step holding a guava, a small signboard leaning beside it with the Hindi word बंदर and its bindi painted red, dappled afternoon light through leaves.

scenes.narration: रंग भी ऐसा है। रं में बिंदी, गुनगुनाती आवाज़।
scenes.caption: Rang is the same. Ran has a bindi, and the sound hums.
scenes.image_brief: Four open pots of powder colour, pink, green, yellow and blue, arranged on a stone floor with a card between them showing the Hindi word रंग and a bold red bindi, bright daylight, festive mood.

scenes.caption: A bindi hides in ghanti too. Ghan, ghanti. Hear it hum.
scenes.image_brief: A small brass bell with a red thread hanging from a doorway hook and still swaying, a paper tag tied below it showing the Hindi word घंटी with the bindi inked in red, warm light from the open door.

scenes.narration: बताओ, बिंदी अंडा में है या आम में? अंडा में, अं।
scenes.caption: Tell me, is the bindi in anda or in aam? In anda, un.
scenes.image_brief: Two cards side by side on a green mat, one showing the Hindi word अंडा with a red bindi above it, one showing आम with no dot, a ripe mango and a white egg placed below their cards, even daylight, playful mood.

scenes.narration: अंडा, बंदर, रंग, घंटी, चारों में बिंदी। बिंदी लगी, आवाज़ गूँजी!
scenes.caption: Anda, bandar, rang, ghanti, all four hold a bindi. Bindi added, it hums!
scenes.image_brief: Four cards laid in a row on a stone courtyard floor showing अंडा, बंदर, रंग and घंटी, every bindi painted the same bright red, a brass bell resting at the end of the row, golden late light.
